subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should OpenClaw accept PR #97485's opt-in iterationBudget contract as the release surface, including config names, default-off behavior, tool-calling-round budget unit, unsupported-harness fail-closed behavior, and budget_exhausted result?
rationale: The implementation is plausible and tested, but it adds strict public config plus core and harness semantics that automation should not finalize without maintainer product intent.

options.title: Confirm Contract And Refresh
options.body: Approve the current round-budget semantics, refresh the branch against current main, rerun the focused proof, and proceed toward merge.

options.title: Rename Or Narrow First
options.body: Adjust the config names, defaults, budget unit, or exhaustion behavior before release so the shipped contract matches maintainer intent.

options.title: Pause Behind #9912
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open while maintainers redesign a single model covering rounds, total tool calls, and timeout-after-first-tool behavior.

recommendation.title: Confirm Contract And Refresh
recommendation.body: Approve the current round-budget semantics, refresh the branch against current main, rerun the focused proof, and proceed toward merge.

likelyOwner.reason: sallyom is assigned to the active implementation candidate and owns the latest follow-up commits on the contract and proof.
